mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate over the past 3 months compresses the risk-free rate, reducing the discount rate applied to future equity cash flows and generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC remains below 0.03 over any 3-year rolling window.

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate rises above 7.5% for two consecutive months, it signals deteriorating labor market conditions that reduce consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when UNRATE exceeds 7.5% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both residential investment (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a weakening housing market, which is a leading indicator of broader consumer demand contraction, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: During periods of declining industrial production (INDPRO) below 95.0 for two consecutive months, manufacturing output contraction signals reduced corporate capacity utilization and potential earnings cuts, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
candidate_trigger: INDPRO falls below 95.0 for 2 consecutive months
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO falls below 95.0 for two consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: When the year-over-year CPI inflation (CPIAUCSL) exceeds 3.0% for two consecutive months, it signals persistent inflation that may trigger premature monetary tightening, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of instances when CPIAUCSL YoY exceeds 3.0% for two consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in non-farm payroll employment (PAYEMS) over the past 3 months indicates strong labor market conditions that boost consumer spending and corporate earnings, generating positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: A simultaneous decline in both real personal consumption (RSAFS) and housing starts (HOUST) indicates a broad-based weakening in consumer demand, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when both RSAFS and HOUST decline for 3 consecutive months, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 3-year window.

mechanism_narrative: In periods when the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2.0%, the risk of monetary tightening increases, causing negative S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS exceeds 2.0%, or Rank IC is below 0.03 over any 2-year window.
